title: Podcast Advertising Guide: Native Reads vs. Host-Read vs. Produced Spots - Matinée Multilingual

facts.fact: The guide's table gives a typical host-read ad length of 60–120 seconds.
facts.quote: | Typical Length | 60–120 seconds | 15–30 seconds | 5–15 minutes (or full episode) |

facts.fact: The guide states that produced spots are pre-recorded, professionally mixed audio ads typically lasting 15–30 seconds.
The guide claims produced spots can run across thousands of shows instantly, a vendor-stated scalability claim.
facts.quote: Highly scalable (can run across thousands of shows instantly).

facts.fact: The guide page was published on 5 January 2026.
The page states that a good benchmark conversion rate for a podcast ad typically ranges between 1% and 2%, and that this can vary by niche, audience engagement, and ad relevance.
Matinée states it has over 40 years of experience providing voice overs for a variety of industries and audiences (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: With over 40 years of experience, we specialise in providing

facts.fact: Matinée says visitors filling out its online Quick Quote form will receive accurate pricing details within one hour.
facts.quote: to get accurate pricing details within the hour.

facts.fact: The page's creative best practices advise hooking the audience within the first 2 seconds of a podcast ad.
facts.quote: Hook the Audience in the First 2 Seconds

facts.fact: The page defines CPM as cost per mille, meaning cost per 1,000 impressions.
The page says there are three main podcast buying paths: podcast ad networks or agencies, self-serve platforms, and direct buys.
facts.quote: there are three main buying paths to consider
